description: This file manages campaign subscriptions within the SuiteCRM platform, including displaying subscription management interfaces, constructing subscription lists, handling subscription and unsubscription logic, and integrating with the SuiteCRM framework for data retrieval and user interface rendering.

methods.name: constructDDSubscriptionList
methods.description: Constructs a drag-and-drop multi-select list of subscribed and unsubscribed email lists for display in the UI.

methods.name: printOriginalValues
methods.description: Generates string representations of current subscription and unsubscription lists for use in the interface.

methods.name: manageSubscriptions
methods.description: Processes user inputs to subscribe or unsubscribe email lists, comparing current selections with original data and calling appropriate methods.
